attchmntText: Rishabh Instruments Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: Rishabh Instruments Limited filed the transcript of its Q2 and H1 FY27 earnings conference call with the NSE and BSE. The call was held on November 16, 2026. Consolidated revenue for H1 FY27 was INR4,111 million, up 6.3% year-on-year. Standalone India business revenue grew 29.6% to INR1,656 million. The Electrical and Electronic Instruments segment contributed 79.2% of consolidated revenue, growing 29.3% year-on-year. Aluminum business revenue declined by approximately 37%. EBITDA margins were 16% for the half year. The company highlighted growth in international markets, including a doubling of US revenue and 24.8% growth in Poland. The transcript is available on the stock exchange records.

attchmntText: Rishabh Instruments Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of Recording
voiceSummary: Rishabh Instruments Limited has uploaded the audio recording of the Earnings Conference Call for Q2 FY 2026-27. The call was held on November 16, 2026. The recording is available on the company website at https://rishabh.co.in/quarterly-filings under the Stock Exchange Information section. The transcript will be uploaded to the website and submitted to the stock exchanges in due course.

attchmntText: Rishabh Instruments Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Rishabh Instruments Limited published its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The advertisements were published in English and Marathi newspapers on November 15, 2026. The information is hosted on the company website. Mega Fin India Limited reported a net loss of 4.58 lakhs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, and a net loss of 4.94 lakhs for the half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board approved these results on November 13, 2026. The company held its Annual General Meetings for financial years ending March 31, 2025, and March 31, 2026, on November 14, 2026. Chase Bright Steel Limited reported a net profit of 334.07 lakhs for the quarter ending September 30, 2026. The company has a registered office at Office D/115, S.MKT., Plot-514 Steel Chamber, Kalamboli Node, Raigarh, Panvel, Maharashtra.
